title: Automate Payment Reminders in Zoho Books #Shorts
description:
Stop chasing clients manually. Learn how to configure automated payment reminders in Zoho Books settings in seconds.

1. Go to Settings › Reminders & Notifications
2. Enable 'Payment Reminders'
3. Set the number of days before/after due date

Daily Zoho fixes - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation. Zoho is a trademark of Zoho Corporation.

#Shorts #ZohoCRM #Zoho #BusinessAutomation

angle.problem: Customers aren't paying invoices on time because reminders are manual.
angle.solution: Configure 'Automated Payment Reminders' in Books settings.
steps: Set the number of days before/after due date
angle.result: Get paid faster without sending manual follow-up emails.
angle.hook: Sick of chasing clients for unpaid invoices?

script.title: Automate Payment Reminders in Zoho Books

lines.say: Sick of chasing clients for unpaid invoices?
lines.tts: Sick of chasing clients for unpaid invoices?

lines.say: Manual follow-ups waste valuable time and consistently delay your cash flow every single month.
lines.tts: Manual follow-ups waste valuable time and consistently delay your cash flow every single month.

lines.say: You can completely eliminate this hassle by configuring automated payment reminders directly inside your Zoho Books settings.
lines.tts: You can completely eliminate this hassle by configuring automated payment reminders directly inside your Zoho Books settings.

lines.say: First, click the gear icon in the top right corner to open Settings, then select Reminders and Notifications from the menu.
lines.tts: First, click the gear icon in the top right corner to open Settings, then select Reminders and Notifications from the menu.

lines.say: Next, locate the main status toggle and click it to enable Payment Reminders for your account.
lines.tts: Next, locate the main status toggle and click it to enable Payment Reminders for your account.

lines.say: Finally, enter the specific number of days before or after the due date that you want the notification emails to go out.
lines.tts: Finally, enter the specific number of days before or after the due date that you want the notification emails to go out.

lines.say: Now you will get paid much faster without ever having to send another manual follow-up email again.
lines.tts: Now you will get paid much faster without ever having to send another manual follow-up email again.
lines.card: Set it up once and done
